create_candidate_penalty_criterion: create a fairseq criterion that applies a (1-p(x_nt)) loss to each negative target candidate token
run_forward_loss: run the forward pass of CandidatePenaltyCrossEntropyCriterion to compute mle loss and custom candidate penalty loss
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training for loss, custom loss, ntokens, and nsentences
compute_ranking_metrics: compute ranking metrics for logits and true token logits using TrainingMetrics.ranking_metrics
build_prev_context_candidates: build negative target candidates from previous context tokens using triangular masking and padding
